title: Recognising coins
examples: Teacher, which coin is worth more?
How many pennies do I need for a dime?
Can you show me a coin that is worth five?

explain.say: Coins are money. You use them to pay in a shop. Each coin has a number on it.
The number tells you what the coin is worth. A one cent coin is worth one cent.
The cent coins are one, two, five, ten, twenty and fifty cent.
There are two euro coins too. One coin is one euro, and one coin is two euro.
A ten cent coin is smaller than a five cent coin. It is worth more. So look at the number.
To count coins, add their numbers. Two cent and one cent make three cent.

faq.q: Why do we use coins for money?
faq.a: We use coins to pay for things in a shop. Coins and notes are money.

faq.q: Which coin is worth the most?
faq.a: Look at the number on the coin. In Ireland, the two euro coin is worth the most.

faq.q: If I have two coins, how do I know the total?
faq.a: Add the numbers on the coins. Two cent and one cent make three cent.
asks: How do I add the coins?
What is the total value of two coins?

faq.q: Are all coins the same shape?
faq.a: Euro coins are all round, but they are different sizes and colours. The twenty cent coin has seven small dips in its edge.
asks: Do all coins look the same?

faq.q: Can I use a coin to count apples?
faq.a: Yes, you can use coins as counters, one coin for each apple. In a shop, coins are used to pay.
asks: Can I count fruit with coins?

facts: Coins are used as a form of money in many countries.
Each coin has a specific value that tells you how much it is worth.
To find the total value, you add the values of the coins together.
A bigger coin is not always worth more. A 10c coin is smaller than a 5c coin.

quiz.say: Look at the coins. Tap the coin worth the most.
quiz.why: Ten is the biggest number here. So the ten cent coin is worth the most.

wrong.0: Five cent is less than ten cent.
wrong.1: Two cent is the smallest of these three coins.

quiz.say: Add the two coins. Tap how much money.
quiz.why: Two cent and two cent make four cent.

wrong.1: Count on two from two, three, four, and you get four cent.
wrong.2: Two and two make four, so five cent is one too many.

quiz.say: Tap the coins that make five cent.

options.say: two cent, two cent and one cent

quiz.why: Two cent and two cent make four cent. One cent more makes five cent.

wrong.0: Two cent and two cent make four cent, one less than five.
wrong.2: Two cent and one cent make three cent.
